**My pick: <Entity category="product" value="BLUETTI AC200L" disambig="2048Wh portable power station"/> at $854.05 with the listed discount code.**

## Important RV limitation

A TT-30 outlet doesn't mean the station supplies the full 30 amps. The BLUETTI's 2,400W inverter provides approximately **20 amps at 120V**.

That is useful for RV lighting, refrigeration, a water pump, and intermittent appliances such as a coffee maker, but it isn't enough to assume you can operate a rooftop air conditioner alongside other loads.

Also, when powering the RV through its shore-power connection, watch the RV's converter: charging the house battery can consume a substantial part of your available power.

**Bottom line:** I'd buy the **BLUETTI AC200L for $854.05** if the discount still works. If minimizing cost matters more than solar capacity and brand preference, the **Growatt INFINITY 2000 PRO at $676.16** deserves a close look. The AC200L is an older model, so verify warranty coverage and availability before ordering.
